title: Don Knuth - Constraint Based Composition
summary: Donald Knuth explains at Stanford's CCRMA the constraint-based methods he is using to compose a major work for pipe organ.
why: Shared as a great talk showing Knuth's musical side and how he applies constraint techniques to composition.

quote.text: Here's a great talk Knuth did at CCRMA @ Stanford last year, on writing pipe organ compositions using Constraint Based techniques.
